newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Cosco (HK) buys 20 pct of Lai Sun Hotels. [CORRECTED 11:37 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Cosco (HK) buys 20 pct of Lai Sun Hotels. [CORRECTED 11:37 GMT]

text.p: Lai Sun Development Co Ltd said on Friday Cosco (Hong Kong) Group Ltd had taken up a 20 percent stake in unit Lai Sun Hotels International Ltd.

Macy Go, assistant vice president for advertising and public relations at Lai Sun Development, told Reuters Cosco (Hong Kong) bought 357 million new shares in Lai Sun Hotels' recent placement of 716 million new shares.
Following the purchase, Cosco (Hong Kong)'s stake in the hotel group stood at 20 percent of its enlarged share capital of 1.79 billion shares (corrects the nature of the 1.79 billion shares).
Officials at Cosco (Hong Kong) were not immediately available to comment.
Earlier this month, Lai Sun Hotels announced a share placement of 716 million new shares to intitutional or professional investors at HK$1.70 per share to raise about HK$1.17 billion after expenses.
Lai Sun Development held 54.09 percent of Lai Sun Hotels as on March 24. Cosco (Hong Kong) is the parent company of Hong Kong-listed Cosco Pacific Ltd.
Lai Sun Hotels and Cosco (Hong Kong) have called a news conference on Friday at 5.30 p.m. local time (0930 GMT).
